fact: WeAreTech Africa reports that the government recently issued an ordinance on digitalisation (an ordinance made by the Head of State, an executive instrument with legal force); the article gives no ordinance number and no date of issue, so as_of is the article's published date.

WeAreTech Africa reports that the ordinance mandates public administrations to digitise services and interconnect systems; the article gives no number for the ordinance and no date of issue, so as_of is the article's published date.

GabonReview reports that the ordinance on digitalisation, signed by President Oligui Nguema, was published in the Journal officiel on 7 September 2025 and for the first time sets a legal framework for e-government in Gabon (an ordinance, executive instrument; no number given in the article).

GabonReview reports that the ordinance on digitalisation establishes mandatory interconnection between administrations to ease exchange of information and simplify procedures, and makes interoperability of information systems a central axis; it also requires public administrations to digitise their services.

Ordonnance N° 0006/PR/2025 portant réglementation de la Digitalisation en République Gabonaise (an ordinance of the President, signed 12 August 2025 and published in Journal Officiel n°81 of 30 August 2025) applies to all State services and to public and private bodies; its art. 3 lists secure sharing of data and art. 6 says digitalisation facilitates sharing and exchange of data, and art. 9 states that information systems must be interoperable; art. 19 leaves implementing provisions to further regulatory texts.
